notes.title: Version 1.01 released: various bug fixes/tweaks
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

A few people have mentioned issues regarding collisions and the controls feeling slightly too slippery.  Most of the issues seemed to be in levels 1-2 and 1-3.

I just released a patch that addresses those concerns.  This patch affects both Windows and Linux builds.


Changes:

- Increased friction a bit, so the player stops more quickly, allowing more precise platforming

- Adjusted collision boxes of various walls and spikes that were causing trouble
